title: Family Portrait in Park, 1930s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot from around 1930 featuring a young family posing together in a leafy park. The father wears a suit jacket with a polka-dot necktie while holding a small child wearing overalls and a bow. The mother stands beside them with a classic 1920s-1930s bob hairstyle. In the background, a body of water and lush foliage frame the scene.
